'''Roosters''' are male [[chicken]]s often found in farms with other chickens. They can be fought as low-level monsters, having similar stats to other chickens and sharing the same drops.

They can be found in [[Freda]]'s yard on the [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]], the chicken pen in [[Rellekka]] and in [[Miscellania]] market.

There is also a non-attackable [[Rooster (Falador farm)|miniature rooster]] in the [[Falador farm]] standing on the top of the box in the chicken pen.
